REMOVAL SERVICE POINT
<<A>> RIVET REMOVAL
Use a drill [φ4.0 − 4.5 mm (φ0.16 − 0.18 inch)] to break the rivet 
by drilling a hole, and remove the rivet.
INSTALLATION SERVICE POINTS
>>A<< SIDE CABLE ASSEMBLY INSTALLATION
1. Feed a wire through the hollow part at the side of the top 
cover assembly.
2. Tie the rear end of the wire to the front end of the side cable 
assembly, pull out the front end of the wire, and then feed 
the side cable assembly through the hollow part.
3. Remove the wire.
>>B<< RIVET INSTALLATION
1. Insert the rivet [φ4.8 mm (φ0.19 inch)] into the No.1 bow and 
side cable tab.
2. Insert "A" of the rivet into the rivet tool. 
3. Pressing the flange surface of the rivet, move the handle of 
the rivet tool.
4. The thinnest point of "A" is cut and the rivet is held in the 
position.
